objective_and_coverage_findings.classification: registered distribution mismatch, not an optimizer implementation bug
objective_and_coverage_findings.effect: The conflict suite improves while original behavior forgets. At 650k original productive action is -3.053 pp and AI delivery is -1.270 versus baseline, while conflict productive action is +5.511 pp and delivery is +0.531.
objective_and_coverage_findings.evidence: Every ordinary and energy reset uses r41 conflict train states; the original suite is evaluation-only.

objective_and_coverage_findings.classification: curriculum semantics/coverage weakness, not reset-sampler arithmetic corruption
objective_and_coverage_findings.effect: Energy starts are late and therefore short. A nominal 20% of episode resets supplies only about 7.9% of PPO transitions from a fixed 192-row bank covering 18/128 scenes, too weak and narrow for a zero-shutdown admission target.
The Actor can improve team return without meeting the registered own-delivery +1/+15% gates. The best conflict AI-delivery result through 650k is only +0.672 (+7.39%) over baseline.
objective_and_coverage_findings.evidence: The native base reward uses team score_delta for both agents; role-specific progress exists, but a program-partner delivery still contributes to robot_2 return.

objective_and_coverage_findings.effect: Shutdown count oscillates rather than converges: 600k->650k is 25->99 on original and 16->79 on conflict.
objective_and_coverage_findings.evidence: Active shaping rewards progress toward the charger and penalizes avoidable WAIT, but distance regression is intentionally disabled when charge_needed and the base shutdown score is team-shared.

objective_and_coverage_findings.effect: Reliable RCPD fidelity does not prevent original-suite forgetting.
objective_and_coverage_findings.evidence: Each refreshed RCPD is extracted from conflict-training trajectories only.

active_shaping.interpretation: All boundary counters exactly reconcile with +.02*productive-.03*avoidable_wait-.02*distance_regression up to float accumulation error.

partner_sampling.interpretation: Counts differ slightly from target percentages because partners are sampled per episode and episode lengths differ; reset frequencies match the registered mix within ordinary sampling noise.

rcpd_kl.interpretation: The code computes KL(pi_nn||program) from detached normalized tree targets and applies it only to robot_2 at bounded lambda .001. No direction, scope, or schedule defect was found.
